title.romaji: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - ROAD TO THE TOP
title.english: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Road to the Top
title.native: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー ROAD TO THE TOP

synonyms: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Road to the Top
ウマ娘ロードトゥーザトップ

node.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

A coolheaded dreamer from the countryside.

Originally hailing from the countryside, she enrolled in Tracen Academy after dominating the racing scene back home. She works to make her hometown proud, but try as she might, her clumsy side always comes out. At the academy, she's known as a fearsome gourmand, able to empty an entire pot of rice in the blink of an eye.

__Height:__ 145 cm

Bringer of misfortune? This racer pursues her dreams despite her dreary outlook.

A timid Umamusume, she is under the impression that any misfortune befalling those around her is entirely her fault, when really, it's just bad timing. Nevertheless, she is determined to eradicate this supposed jinx of hers. She loves reading picture books in her spare time, especially "The Blue Rose of Good Fortune."

alternative: Supreme Ruler of the Century's End

node.description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

The pompous star of the stage. Her laugh fills the room!

Opera O's behavior is always over-exaggerated, sometimes loudly, and you will often hear her proclaiming her greatness in some way or other. She seriously believes that those who do not know their own beauty and strength are unhappy, and she works tirelessly every day to enlighten them. She's friends with and admired by [Meisho Doto ](https://anilist.co/character/211557/Meishou-Dotou).

A member of Team Rigil as well as rival to [Narita Top Road ](https://anilist.co/character/273332/Narita-Top-Road) and [Admire Vega ](https://anilist.co/character/273331/Admire-Vega).

__Height:__ 158 cm

Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream.

Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend. Now, she hopes to make both her moms proud by fulfilling her promise of becoming Japan's top racer. Though she may falter along the way, her indomitable spirit ensures that she runs ever forward.

Extremely haughty. Her pride extends to the heavens!

An Umamusume with an unbreakable spirit, King Halo is ready to overcome any challenge in order to be recognized by all as a first-class lady. Despite their strained relationship, she hopes to one day be recognized by her mother—a first-rate Umamusume and designer—and prove herself as a daughter. Yet to her gaggle of admirers at the academy, there's no doubt in their minds that she's already worthy of the title of "King," and they do not hesitate to regularly hail her as such.

__Height:__ 140 cm

No matter how many times she falls, this girl always picks herself back up!

She's on a losing streak... but she never gives up! While she may not be the most skilled, she experienced the excitement of racing back in Kochi and wanted more. While she completely flunked Tracen's entrance exam, her admissions officer was nonetheless impressed when they spoke by her boundless possibility—which she spreads to all the Umamusume around her. 

She is based on the internationally-famed racehorse of the same name with a record of 0 wins and 113 losses.

__Height:__ 164 cm

In order to change her outlook and herself, this pessimist gives it her all.

Her self-esteem droops as low as her ears. Things never seem to go quite right for this clumsy girl. Even so, she's determined to change herself for the better and doesn't want to ever give up, all for the chance at securing a brighter future. She admires [T.M. Opera O](https://anilist.co/character/140845/TM-Opera-O)'s grandiose self-confidence.

__Height:__ 157 cm

The lone star that shines brightest. She carries the weight of her immense resolve.

A somewhat gloomy Umamusume who tends to avoid company. A certain tragedy that took place early in her life affects her deeply, even making her racing activities seem like an attempt to atone. Though she doesn't intend it, her stoic pessimism garners the interest and concern of those around her, and she often gets caught up in the antics of T.M. Opera O, one of her racing peers. 

~!Admire Vega reveals that she was to be born with a twin sister, but that only one of them could survive until birth (presumably due to complications). Therefore she finds herself guilty of taking away her sister's right to run.!~

__Height:__ 166 cm

An energetic honor student! ...But also kind of a supporting character?

A spirited competitor practically overflowing with positive energy. She wants nothing more than to meet the expectations of her fans and is determined to surmount any challenge to do so. Her willingness to acknowledge and compliment her competitors' strengths has earned her the popularity and respect of her peers. Though she has the makings of a star, she often seems to find herself in more of a supporting role.

__Height:__ 155 cm

Does what she wants, when she wants. As free as a drifting cloud...

As one of the most easygoing girls you'll meet, she lives life at her own pace. But on the inside, she's quite the schemer, and her laziness is just an act to get others to let down their guard... sometimes. Her hobbies include taking afternoon naps and fishing. She also loves cats and is often seen curling up with them outside on the grass. She's classmates with [Special Week](https://anilist.co/character/125299/Special-Week).

__Height:__ 160 cm

Always follows commands! The cyborg Umamusume.

An Umamusume also known as the "Cyborg". She views the world through the lens of programming and databases, carrying out her objectives in an expressionless and robotic manner. Even so, she is not an emotionless machine—her constant training since her youth has simply resulted in less interactions with people, leading to her current personality. Underneath that robotic shell, she does indeed have feelings.

**Height:** 143 cm

I love Umamusume! A super versatile otaku.

A veritable Umamusume otaku. She came to Tracen Academy to be close to all of her favorite runners. She does respect boundaries, however, and tries to stay out of trouble. She's eager to get up close and personal with as many Umamusume as possible, and to that end she has revealed surprising ability on both dirt and turf.

__Height:__ 163 cm

Fortune be with me! This charm-tastic Umamusume loves fortune-telling.

A fortune-telling fanatic and lover of the supernatural, she's content to leave the outcomes of races and many other things up to luck. If she's not divining for her own sake, then she's divining for someone else's. She places an immense faith in a revelation from a certain god stating that as long as she keeps running, the way forward will open up before her. The name of the cat shaped bag that she carries is "Miss Nya."

__Height:__ 155 cm

A shining star of pure cuteness! I need lots of love and attention, okay?

When you think of "cute," you think of Curren Chan, and when you think of Curren Chan, you think of the selfie goddess boasting over 3 million followers on Umastagram. Realizing just how adorable she was from the moment she was born, she's used her natural charm to bend her parents and seniors alike to her whims. Thanks to that, she is able to climb the social ladder of life with ease. To show everyone just how cute she is, she now aims for the top of the Twinkle Series.

__Height__: 158 cm

This class representative's gone wild! Full Speed Bakushiiiin!

A class representative who'll rush recklessly into any situation. Once her mind is set on something, she'll bakushin dash straight to her goal—often causing more chaos than she helps resolve. She never acts out of self-righteousness, however, and tends to feel downhearted if no one is asking for her assistance. Her aptitude for sprinting is quite overwhelming, and she is confident she can outrun anyone with unmatched speed.

__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")

A sheltered lady excited to make memories that will last a lifetime.

A lady of a distinguished family that is rumored to be royalty, she has come to Tracen as an exchange student from Ireland. Perhaps due to a sheltered childhood, she's very curious about everything, which can lead to some sticky situations. She hopes to make a lot of memories while at the academy.

__Height__: 156 cm

Leave the fanservice to her! Self-proclaimed future top Umadol.

An Umamusume idol, or Umadol for short. She's always focused on looking cute while winning, and aims to be the center at every winning concert. She loves to interact with her fans and participates in any event that may serve as good publicity. Despite being a proficient dirt racer, she has a slight complex about being associated with the unsightly substance.
